title: 36 Offences Under Local And Special Laws. 1.7. A total number of 29,84,654 offences were reported under the local and special laws during 1986 against a total of 14,05,835 cognizable cases registered in 1986 under the Indian Penal Code and 30,96,481 cases under the Local and Special Laws registered in 1985. There was thus a decline of 3.6% in the crime under Local and Special Laws over the year 1985 figures. As compared to 1985 the number of cases registered was less under all the crime heads of Local and Special Laws except Prohibition Act, Customs Act and Indian Railways Act. The States which registered highest number of cases under Local and Special Laws was Tamil Nadu (8,19,473) followed by Andhra Pradesh (5,49,723), Maharashtra 5,09,589 Karnataka (3,71,896), Uttar Pradesh (2,29,110), Gujarat (1,68,440) and West Bengal (1,10,500). In India, as a whole the number of cases registered under the Local and Special Laws is more than twice the number of cases registered under the Indian Penal Code.
